definitions.full: H4507. Meni מְנִי proper name, of a divinity Menî, god of fate ( award, apportionment ; compare Arabic proper name, of divinity. Maniyyât , and perhaps Manât , We Skizzen iii.22 f. 189, , Nö ZMG xi. 1886, 709 ; in Nabataean מנותו Eut Nab. No. 2, 1. 5, etc .); — מִמְסָךְ לַמְנִי מִלֵּא Isa 65:11 (|| לַגַּד ) — see Che Di Bae Semitic Rel. 79 .
